templates.name: Invoice sent to customer
templates.bodyHtml:
Dear {CustomerName},

Please find attached invoice {InvoiceNumber}.

Invoice date{InvoiceDate}
Amount{CurrencyCode} {TotalAmount}
Due date{DueDate}

{Message}

If you have any questions about this invoice, just reply to this email.

Kind regards,
{CompanyName}
{CompanyEmail} · {CompanyPhone}

templates.name: Quotation sent to customer
templates.bodyHtml:
Dear {CustomerName},

Thank you for your inquiry. Please find attached our quotation {QuotationNumber}.

Quotation date{QuotationDate}
Amount{CurrencyCode} {TotalAmount}
Valid until{ValidUntil}

{Message}

To go ahead, simply reply to this email and we will confirm your order.

Kind regards,
{CompanyName}
{CompanyEmail} · {CompanyPhone}

templates.name: Purchase order sent to supplier
templates.bodyHtml:
Dear {SupplierName},

Please find attached purchase order {PoNumber}.

Order date{PoDate}
Amount{CurrencyCode} {TotalAmount}
Required delivery{DeliveryDate}

{Message}

Please confirm receipt of this order and the expected delivery date, and quote the PO number on your delivery note and invoice.

Kind regards,
{CompanyName}
{CompanyEmail} · {CompanyPhone}

templates.name: Payment reminder
templates.bodyHtml:
Dear {CustomerName},

Our records show that the following invoice is now {DaysOverdue} days past its due date.

Invoice{InvoiceNumber}
Due date{DueDate}
Amount due{CurrencyCode} {AmountDue}

If you have already paid, please ignore this reminder and accept our thanks. Otherwise, we would be grateful for payment at your earliest convenience.

Kind regards,
{CompanyName}
{CompanyEmail} · {CompanyPhone}

templates.name: Payment received
templates.bodyHtml:
Dear {CustomerName},

We have received your payment. Thank you.

Receipt{PaymentNumber}
Date{PaymentDate}
Amount{CurrencyCode} {AmountPaid}
Applied to{InvoiceNumber}

Your receipt is attached for your records.

Kind regards,
{CompanyName}
{CompanyEmail} · {CompanyPhone}

templates.name: Welcome to the team
templates.bodyHtml:
Hello {FirstName},

You have been invited to join {OrganizationName}.

Accept your invitation

Your user name is {UserName}. After accepting, sign in at {LoginUrl}.

The invitation link expires in 7 days.

Kind regards,
{CompanyName}
{CompanyEmail} · {CompanyPhone}

templates.name: Payslip sent to employee
templates.bodyHtml:
Dear {EmployeeName},

Your payslip for {PayPeriod} is attached.

Net pay{CurrencyCode} {NetPay}

Please contact HR if anything on your payslip looks wrong.

Kind regards,
{CompanyName}
{CompanyEmail} · {CompanyPhone}

notes: Placeholders per docs/onboarding/TEMPLATE-PLACEHOLDERS.md (TPL). PayslipSent is sent by HRM (D-93).
